LanguageData.RM_SteamDevilAppearsDesc: A column of boiling vapor has spun up off the river and is wandering the map. It scalds anything it crosses and can knock down weaker trees — heat-rated armor gives no protection against it.
LanguageData.RM_SteamDevilLeftMap: The steam devil has wandered off the map.
LanguageData.RM_SteamDevilAppearsFromRoil: A shape boils up from the fog
LanguageData.RM_SteamDevilAppearsFromRoilDesc: The standing ground-fog over the river itself has thrown up a steam devil, unprompted by any lull in the weather. It scalds anything it crosses and can knock down weaker trees — heat-rated armor gives no protection against it.
